_notes: Civilizations phase 1 (game/sim/Space/Civilizations.cs reads this through game/sim/Data/GameData.Civilizations.cs; contract docs/civilizations-contract.md; design doc "Civilizations & First Contact" claude.ai/artifact/A8NZp9KCb7pft9mo7xLbYB). Natives and ruins are rolled with a generated star system from its seed (never the colony's landing body, at most one site per body); the player learns about them through the system fog (Detected/Scanned: artificial signals from L3 up; Charted: species, a level range, population, awareness), study from orbit (ship ×1, satellite ×2, hidden observation post ×4) narrows the range to the exact level and reveals temperament, unity and nations. Hidden posts risk discovery (awareness, an incident, Starfleet Standing for the Federation in eras with the Prime Directive). rules.json: site odds and body weights, awareness, study, observation research, the post, Standing. levels.json: L1..L6. names.json: species and nation name parts (generated names). ruins.json: ruin kinds (phase 2 digs; list only). All numbers are placeholders.
